note: Netflix Conformity Monkey's opt-out, as a ratchet. Every rule that fails a declared check must appear here with a named owner, a reason a reader can check, and a DATE IT LAPSES. scripts/check-conformity.ts fails on a nonconformity that is absent, fails again when an entry's expiresOn has passed, and fails when an entry exists for a rule that now conforms - so this set can only shrink. Generated as a baseline from the 2026-10-02 measurement; every later change is hand-edited and reviewed. The owner is the documented maintainer of record (docs/MAINTAINERS.md) because the registry carries no per-rule owner yet - a solo-maintainer acknowledgement, recorded as one rather than dressed as a distributed one. --leashed runs every check and sends nothing.
